# UX & Accessibility Requirements Quality Checklist: Sidebar SVG Icons

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements for the sidebar SVG-icon replacement are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before implementation — "unit tests for the spec", not for the code.
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus**: UX/visual-consistency and accessibility requirement quality, plus scope/consistency.
**Depth**: Standard · **Audience**: Reviewer / PR

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are icon requirements defined for every sidebar position in scope — logo, the three nav entries, and logout — with no position left unspecified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the out-of-scope boundary (fleet-list icons, header chevron, §4.2 quality-indicator "barras" icon) stated clearly enough that a reviewer can tell exactly which sidebar icons are excluded? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the behaviour requirements for a failed/missing icon render documented, and do they state that the text label and navigation must survive? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for icon behaviour under a narrow viewport or zoomed text (no overlap, labels not pushed out)? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec state whether icon colour requirements apply to both active and inactive nav states, and to focus/hover states, or document that focus/hover are out of scope? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are the authoritative icon values (shape, size, stroke, logo colour) pinned to a single named source that a reviewer can check against, rather than described vaguely as "per the design"? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "crisp, consistent icons that look identical" stated as an objectively checkable condition (same shapes/sizes/colour from the reference) rather than a subjective impression? [Clarity, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "marked decorative" defined concretely enough (ignored by assistive technology) that two reviewers would agree on whether a given icon satisfies it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "adopt the surrounding text colour" expressed so it is unambiguous which element's colour each icon inherits in each state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Does FR-009's "must not add a new third-party icon dependency" make clear what counts as a dependency (library vs. inline markup vs. local asset)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the icon-to-entry assignments (Central en vivo = pulse, Alertas = bell, Plan del día = calendar, logout = exit, logo = pulse) agree across spec, research.md (R2), data-model.md, and the US-06 §4.2 reference? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the set of residual glyphs to eliminate (`⬳ ◉ ✚ ▦ ⇥`) consistent with the actual glyphs the current component renders, so FR-006 matches what exists? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the icon sizes (logo 26×26, menu 20×20, logout 18×18) and logo colour (`#FBBF24`) stated identically wherever they recur across spec, research, data-model, and quickstart? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the success criteria IDs referenced in artifacts resolve to real entries — in particular does quickstart's "SC-006/FR-006" reference reconcile with spec.md, which defines FR-006 but no SC-006? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §SC-001–SC-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-001 ("100% of icon positions show the design-defined icon, 0 glyphs remain") be objectively verified against a fixed count of positions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-002 (same icons across machines regardless of fonts) measurable with a defined comparison method rather than a subjective judgement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Does SC-003 identify which "existing accessibility check" must keep passing specifically enough to be re-run and judged pass/fail? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK018 Is SC-005's "frontend quality gate stays green" tied to named, checkable gates (lint, type check, coverage >80%, build) with a stated threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK019 Does every functional requirement (FR-001–FR-009) map to at least one measurable success criterion or acceptance scenario? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Requirements]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for the active-entry case so the active indication and icon legibility are preserved after the swap? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements stated for the inactive-entry icon appearance (colour inheritance) and not only the active entry? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Does the spec cover the "icon fails to render" exception path as a requirement, not only as prose, so it is testable? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the primary user-visible outcomes (consistency) and the protective outcomes (accessibility, unchanged labels) both represented as distinct, independently verifiable stories? [Coverage, Spec §US1, §US2]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 Are accessibility requirements for the icons (decorative, no announced content, labels unchanged) complete enough to re-verify without inspecting implementation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the "no runtime cost / no real-time path touched" expectation captured as a requirement or assumption, so a reviewer knows performance is intentionally out of scope? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the coverage-gate constraint (>80% on four metrics) stated as a requirement the change must not regress, with the measurement scope (whole `src` tree) acknowledged? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005, Plan §Constraints]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 Is the assumption that the three nav entries and the logout control already exist, and that only icon presentation changes, stated and validated against the current component? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the dependency on the US-06 §4.1–4.3 style spec (and UXUI-03 layout) explicit, with the specific values treated as authoritative rather than illustrative? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the Turn-1 / Adaptive-lane / frontend-only classification recorded so the reviewer can confirm no deferred-turn norm (RBAC, map, Redis) is implicated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the assumption that no message contract or persisted schema is affected (FR-009) stated clearly enough to justify skipping the contracts artifact? [Assumption, Spec §FR-009, Research §R4]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK031 Is there any ambiguity in whether the logo icon must inherit `currentColor` or use the fixed brand colour `#FBBF24`, given FR-004 scopes colour inheritance to nav/logout only? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK032 Does the spec avoid conflicting direction about whether icon markup lives inline vs. in a separate module, or is that correctly deferred to the plan/research as an implementation decision? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Research §R1]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the quickstart "Done when" list free of success-criterion identifiers that do not exist in spec.md (e.g. SC-006), to avoid a dangling acceptance reference? [Conflict, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- CHK014 and CHK033 track the only concrete cross-artifact defect found (the `SC-006` reference in quickstart.md; spec.md defines no SC-006)
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
